main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). One of Victoria's premier provincial championship courses featuring a spacious 2,040m circumference, 24m width, and a 380m home straight. The broad layout and wide cambered turns provide an exceptionally fair galloping surface where mid-field stalkers ('P') and closing swoopers ('S') get every opportunity on Good ground.
main_turf.post_bias: Extremely fair course. Long run-ins from chutes (1200m, 1400m, 1700m, 2200m) give wider draws ample time to find cover without burning early energy.

handicapping_angles.spacious_2040m_championship_layout: Geelong's broad 24m width and cambered turns eliminate tight-turn leader traps. Upgrade large-striding gallopers and genuine closing swoopers ('S').
handicapping_angles.geelong_cup_spring_carnival_class: The October Geelong Cup ($500k Group 3) is a primary Melbourne Cup lead-up feature. During Cup day and Spring Carnival meetings, track class elevates to Group/Metro grade (+4.0 speed par offset).
handicapping_angles.melbourne_metro_shippers: Geelong is a major regional target for premier Melbourne metropolitan stables (Ciaron Maher, Busuttin/Young, Price/Kent Jr., Moody/Coleman, Ben, Will & JD Hayes). Upgrade class-dropping Metro runners (+3.0 pts).

par_adjustment.tier: Tier 2 (Victorian Premier Metro Alternate HQ / Geelong Cup)
